title: Primož Roglič Lands a Contract to Join NSN Cycling for 2027
content:
Roglič signs late-hour deal with NSN Cycling for 2027 that will keep the popular Slovenian in the WorldTour for at least one more season.

Read the full article at Primož Roglič Lands a Contract to Join NSN Cycling for 2027 on Velo.
author: ahood
